Web 2.0: Data Visualization and Social Networking

 Web 2.0 is a generic term that often refers to design considerations
 associated with the development and deployment of next generation
 tools built upon the internet.
 These design considerations emphasize user centric design
 principals and put engage user experience at a premium as well as
 effective communication.
 As a data scientist interested in telling “data stories”, this movement
 involves all of the initiatives I want to engage in.
 Engaging all users in the exploration of data through the
 development of compelling data visualizations.
